will_it_rain.name: Will It Rain? -- Weather Risk Prediction System
will_it_rain.tech: React, Leaflet, Chart.js, NASA POWER API
points: Built a weather analytics platform using NASA climate data to predict event risks.
Integrated geospatial input with multi-parameter analysis (temperature, rain, wind, humidity).
Developed interactive charts to visualize trends and probability insights.
Enabled data export (CSV/JSON) for planning and decision-making.

smart_traffic.name: AI-Based Smart Traffic System Using Computer Vision
points: Architected a YOLO-v8 detection pipeline achieving 94% accuracy across varied traffic conditions.
Optimized simulated intersection throughput by 25% via adaptive signal control algorithms.
Engineered low-latency model inference for real-time edge deployment and scene analysis with less than 200ms latency.

cert_generator.name: Certificate Generator and Verification System
points: Automated high-throughput certificate generation for 1,000+ records per batch, reducing manual effort by 90%.
Engineered a secure QR-based verification system enabling instant credential validation.
Developed an interactive canvas editor supporting dynamic layouts and reusable template components.

irrigo.name: IRRIGO -- Smart Irrigation Platform
points: Developed an AI-assisted irrigation platform integrating satellite and weather data for precision scheduling.
Optimized agricultural water usage by ~20% through data-driven analysis of 50+ farm scenarios.
Architected a full-stack analytics dashboard for real-time monitoring and environmental telemetry.

droidops.name: DroidOps -- Android Device Management GUI
points: Engineered a native Rust/Tauri desktop GUI for ADB, improving process execution efficiency by 40%.
Leveraged Rust's memory safety and concurrency model to handle multi-device synchronization.
Streamlined device lifecycle management through batch processing features and optimized shell access.

glyphdeck.name: GlyphDeck -- Desktop Font Manager
points: Architected a high-performance Go application indexing 1,200+ fonts with sub-500ms retrieval latency.
Optimized system overhead to achieve a lightweight 25MB native executable using the Wails framework.
Enhanced user productivity by 40% through optimized metadata parsing and efficient search algorithms.
